summary: Simple, correct one-line default change directly resolving inconsistent upload permissions described in the issue; low risk since it's a settings default users can override.

issues.description: Changes default file permissions for existing deployments that rely on umask-derived permissions and don't set FILE_UPLOAD_PERMISSIONS explicitly; behavior change should be called out in release notes (not shown in this diff).
Corresponding settings documentation (docs/ref/settings.txt) and release notes likely need updating to reflect the new default, not included in this diff.
